Furthermore, the recent profit growth has outperformed price growth by only 24%, as indicated in the PRICE-LED signal [E57], which suggests that TIIL may be facing challenges in translating earnings into stock prices. This could indicate a disconnect between market expectations and actual performance, further supporting the notion of overvaluation.
